The text follows a Pros & Cons/ Evaluative Pattern:
Introduction (Para 1): Introduces lab-grown meat and states the thesis (examining both its promises and problems).
Pros (Para 2): Highlights benefits—eliminating animal cruelty, lowering greenhouse emissions ($96\%$), and boosting nutrition.
Cons (Para 3): Raises concerns—high energy consumption, health/allergy risks, and potential lack of taste/texture.
Conclusion (Para 4): Summarizes it as an innovative global trend and calls for comprehensive research before mainstream adoption.
